# wangsu_waap_ratelimits_v2 (Data Source)

Use this data source to query rate limiting rules (v2). This data source allows you to query rate limiting rules using the v2 API, which supports multi-dimensional statistical granularity and IP Blocking action.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "wangsu_waap_ratelimit_v2" "demo" {
  domain      = "waap.test30.com"
  rule_name   = "web_ip_ua_v2"
  description = "your_description"
  scene       = "WEB"

  statistical_items {
    statistical_item = "IP"
  }
  statistical_items {
    statistical_item = "COOKIE"
    statistics_keys  = ["session_id"]
  }

  statistical_period = 600
  trigger_threshold  = 1000
  intercept_time     = 600
  effective_status   = "WITHOUT"

  rate_limit_effective {
    effective = ["MON", "FRI"]
    start     = "07:00"
    end       = "18:00"
    timezone  = "17"
  }

  action = "IP_BLOCK"

  rate_limit_rule_condition {
    ip_or_ips_conditions {
      match_type = "NOT_EQUAL"
      ip_or_ips  = ["192.168.1.11", "192.168.1.1/22"]
    }
    ua_conditions {
      match_type = "EQUAL"
      ua         = ["ua11", "ua21"]
    }
  }
}

data "wangsu_waap_ratelimits_v2" "demo" {
  domain_list = [wangsu_waap_ratelimit_v2.demo.domain]
}
output "waap_ratelimit_v2" {
  value = data.wangsu_waap_ratelimits_v2.demo
}
```
